dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep, continuous concave curvature from the basal ridge to the apex, forming a smooth falcate spline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point is classified as rounded, characterized by a medium-radius arc rather than an acute or obtuse point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a consistent diagonal slope of approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 2.8:1, indicating a wide, low-profile dorsal structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive light-grey mottling and depigmented patches are visible across the lateral surface of the fin and back, consistent with healed rake marks or epidermal lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular small notch is visible on the lower third of the trailing edge boundary.
